assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game VFX sprite sheet, ONE healing/protection effect, not a finished scene. Create a clean 3-column by 2-row atlas of SIX ordered frames on a genuinely transparent background. Each of the six equal square cells is isolated, with ample empty margins and same effect center and floor baseline. Crisp hand-crafted 16-bit tactical RPG pixel art, deliberate visible pixel clusters, dark-edged small forms, no smooth vector shapes, no blurry bloom. Intended to overlay one tiny 24px tactical-map character, not a group or battlefield. Palette: muted jade green, celadon mint, soft ivory highlights, restrained teal shadows. The effect is a small horizontal elliptical healing halo at the recipient's feet with two graceful upward ribbons and a few leaf-shaped sparks; at its peak it suggests vitality/strong body, no bubble shield, no armored person. Ordered cells: 1 tiny gathering seed light above the foot ellipse, 2 ellipse opens and a short ribbon rises, 3 narrow double ribbons wrap upward, 4 one clear bright healing crest with small leaves, 5 ribbons break into a few fading leaves, 6 only subtle residual motes. Keep the entire effect inside each cell. This is one heal, no repeated explosion or extra impact. No characters, weapons, scenery, ground texture, letters, numbers, words, captions, grid lines, cell borders, logos or checkerboard baked into the image. Keep consistent aligned registration of all six frames.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one upgraded single-recipient healing VFX atlas for a 16-bit tactical RPG. Draw exactly SIX isolated animation frames in a clean 3-column by 2-row arrangement, each equal square cell, on a genuinely transparent background. No frame borders or labels. Crisp visible pixel clusters with restrained glow and clean silhouette, intended for a small 24px map character. Palette mainly soft ivory-white and pale warm gold, jade-green secondary ribbons and turquoise shadows, clearly distinct from a basic mostly green healing effect. A small oval light seal under one person's feet, an elegant pair of luminous rising ribbons and several small pointed leaf/ray sparks. The peak is taller and more structured than basic healing, like a brief open crown of warm light around one recipient, but no giant area attack, no bubble, no solid shield, no person. Sequence reading left to right then next row: gathering glint, oval opens with first ribbon, double ribbon ascends, ONE bright healing crest with warm crown rays, soft spiral releases leaf-like motes, almost-gone residual specks. Same center and ground baseline in every cell; keep wide transparent margins so none of the effects touch cell edges or adjacent cells. No ground or environment, no text/numbers, no runes resembling letters, no crosses, no characters, no weapon, no watermark, no checkerboard background. One heal/protection event, not six separate explosions.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE small transparent tactical RPG status icon, for a temporary physical defence bonus named Strong Body (but NO text in image). Create a single compact square pixel-art emblem, centered with transparent outer margins, readable when displayed at 24 by 24 pixels. Depict a sturdy silver-blue breastplate/chest armor silhouette with broad shoulders, a small celadon/jade vitality gem in the sternum, and two restrained sage-green leaf accents near the lower sides. Clearly armor/body resilience, not a shield/bubble, not a muscular person, no helmet/face/weapon. Dark navy pixel outline, cool silver highlights, muted jade and sage green, crisp deliberate pixel clusters consistent with 16-bit fantasy tactical map characters. Minimal internal detail so the torso is legible at tiny size, polished hand-painted pixel sprite look, no glossy 3D rendering, no soft bloom. Keep design clear on both snowy light ground and navy UI. No panel, border frame, round coin, circle backing, numbers, letters, badge counter, name, plus sign, watermark, scenery or checkerboard. A countdown badge will be added separately in UI; leave the lower-right outer margin fairly open. Genuinely transparent background, no black filled canvas.
